text:
morgan: Hey all — spontaneous Smash / Steam key drop tomorrow night? thinking mezz projector + Deck corner + snack table.
eli: count me in. I can bring two wired controllers and a spare HDMI cable.
tara: I have a stack of spare Humble keys I can leave on the snack table with a note 'take one, pay it forward'.
vik: I can bring my Steam Deck and a small capture dongle if anyone wants short clips. Happy to run a tiny 4-player Smash bracket.
claire: :thumbsup: for bracket. Also can we have a low-key rule: no campaign spoilers in chat during the event?
events-bot: Quick poll: Start time 7pm or 8pm? React :one: for 7pm, :two: for 8pm. Poll expires in 12h.
morgan: :one:
eli: :one:
tara: :two: (later works better for me)
claire: I'll bring folding chairs and a small power strip. Anyone with an ethernet switch? Parsec folks prefer wired.
vik: I can bring a 5-port gigabit switch and two cables.
morgan: Plan: setup 6:30 for a 7pm start, bracket signups open at 7:10, casual Steam co-op on the side. Leave spare keys on snack table with label.
eli: pizza order? I can handle. Veg + gluten-free option?
tara: I'll bring a few gluten-free granola bars and some soda.
claire: projector volunteer? happy to run input switching for the first hour.
events-bot: Calendar event created: "Smash + Keydrop Night" (root_ts: 1987654321).
morgan: RSVP here if you want a guaranteed controller or charger slot. See y'all tomorrow! :sparkles:
